changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: Configurable schemas: dim (SCD2), fact, staging. DuckDB supports SCHEMA.
changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS dim
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS fact
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS hedge_bronze
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS hedge_silver
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS hedge_gold

rollback.sql: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS dim CASCADE
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS fact CASCADE
